messages:
Maya: FYI opened helpdesk ticket HD-482 — observed a 6hr spike yesterday that consumed ~320 GPU-hours from 'experimental-pool' with no team tag. can someone triage ownership? :eyes:
Alex: Ugh. Any allocation IDs or project labels in the billing export?
Maya: I pulled the raw export, looks like these entries all have project_id=playground-project but no team tag. pasted sample below:
Maya: ```
resource: n1-standard-16
project_id: playground-project
sku: NVIDIA_T4
start_time: 2025-06-12T02:12:00Z
end_time: 2025-06-12T08:20:00Z
usage_hours: 6.13
cost: 480.23
labels: {}
```
Emma: playground-project is shared for onboarding experiments. We ask teams to add label team=xxx but onboarding scripts sometimes miss it.
FinBot: Automated alert: untagged_gpu_hours > 100 in 24h for project playground-project. See https://billing.redwood.internal/reports/untagged?proj=playground-project
Ryan: Can we map IAM activity to see who created the instances? If it's an ephemeral sandbox user we can reassign to their team and backfill tags.
Alex: Good plan. @DevOpsGCP can you run a quick query to join compute.instances.list events with the billing window? something like:
Alex: ```sql
SELECT user, instance_id, timestamp FROM audit_logs.compute WHERE project = 'playground-project' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2025-06-12' AND '2025-06-13';
```
DevOpsGCP: On it. Running now, will post results here.
DevOpsGCP: Quick findings: 3 users launched instances during window: ryan.sandbox, onboarding-bot, lincoln.ryan@acme.com (external). onboarding-bot used automated test harness that didn’t set labels.
Maya: external user sticks out. Could that be a partner trial that shouldn't consume internal GPU credits?
Emma: yes — partner trials should bill to customer accounts, not playground. We need to check the trial onboarding flow.
Ryan: I can follow up with Partnerships to see if that Acme trial was configured correctly. Also recommend we run a backfill script to apply team=partner_acme to those specific instance IDs and update ledger.
Alex: Finance: will you accept a backfilled tag and ledger adjustment or do you need a formal invoice correction? tagging + ledger update is usually fine, but if cost has been billed to a customer we may need a journal entry.
Maya: Finance team pinged via ticket. @FinBot can you add an approval checkbox to HD-482 so finance can sign off on the backfill?
FinBot: Added approval field to HD-482: "finance_approval_needed". Current status: pending.
DevOpsGCP: Backfill script prepared, will run after finance approval. Script will: 1) tag instances with team=partner_acme 2) create ledger adjustment entry referencing HD-482 3) emit audit log.
Emma: Also proposing a hard guardrail: terraform/google infra templates should enforce required label team in instance creation and onboarding-bot updated to populate team label.
Ryan: Agreed — short-term backfill + long-term enforcement. I'll own the onboarding-bot patch.
Maya: Thanks all — assigning next actions in HD-482: DevOps run backfill after finance approval; Ryan contact Partnerships; Emma patch onboarding flow; Alex confirm ledger entry format. Will update thread when HD-482 status changes. :white_check_mark:
